home.title: Canada, made *for you*.
home.intro1: We're a small team of Canada specialists. We plan private journeys across the second-largest country on Earth, which is mostly a matter of telling people what not to do.
home.intro2: Banff, Toronto and Québec City in ten days? Possible. Enjoyable? Not really. We'll tell you what fits, when the bears turn up, and why winter is a different trip altogether.
home.heroSummer: Summer: long days, open roads, bears on the rivers.
home.heroWinter: Winter: short days, long nights, the sky does the work.
home.specialistIntro: One person plans your trip from first call to last day. They've been where you're going, usually in the wrong season, so you don't have to.
home.value1Body: If a lodge is overrated, or a drive is longer than it looks on a map, we say so. Most of our best advice is about what to leave out.
home.value2Body: We know which week the larches turn, which floatplane pilot to ask for, and which road closes in October. Then we plan around it.
home.journeysIntro: Starting points, not packages. Every one is private and gets rebuilt around you.
home.experiencesIntro: Most people want a bit of each. That's fine. We'll keep it to a sensible number of flights.
home.destinationsIntro: Nine provinces and territories worth planning around. Each one is better at some things than others.
home.calendarIntro: Canada runs to a natural schedule. Here's this month and next.
home.contactIntro: Tell us roughly what you have in mind. We'll reply within one working day, with honest advice and no obligation.
home.pressIntro: A few kind words from the press. Placeholders for now, while we earn the real ones.
home.statement: Vancouver to Halifax is further than London to *Cairo*. Plan accordingly.

legal.placeholder: Placeholder. This page needs to be written by a lawyer before launch.
legal.accessibilityBody: We want this site to work for everyone. It's built to WCAG 2.2 AA: it works with a keyboard and screen readers, respects reduced-motion settings, and keeps text readable. If something gets in your way, tell us at {email} and we'll fix it, or help you plan by phone instead.
legal.privacyBody: We collect only what you send us: your name, contact details and what you tell us about your trip. We use it to plan your journey and, if you ask, to send our newsletter. We don't sell it. Full policy to follow.
legal.termsBody: Deposits, payments, changes and cancellations will be set out here, along with our provincial travel seller registration and what it protects. Full terms to follow.
